Dinesh Paswan @ Dinesh Kumar Paswan vs The State Of Bihar
on 7 May, 2025
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna
 Criminal Miscellaneous No.87599 of 2024
 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-15 Year-2024 Thana- Mahila P.S. Distri

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Dinesh Paswan @ Dinesh Kumar Paswan S/O Sugam Lal Paswan Resident of
Village- Sonamani Godown, Police Station- Kursakanta, District- Araria.

... 
 Versus
 The State of Bihar
 ... ... Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Mukesh Kumar Rana, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Dr. Ajeet Kumar, App

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sourendra Pandey
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Araria Mahila P.S. Case No. 15 of 2024 registered for the offences under Sections 341, 323, 376, 504, 506, 509/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The prosecution case in nutshell is that the petitioner had committed rape of informant-Shastri Kumari.
The FIR also states that the petitioner had demanded Rs. 5,00,000/- as ransom in order to marry the informant.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.

Learned counsel further submits that during the course of trial neither the mother of the informant nor the informant Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.87599 of 2024(4)
dt.07-05-2025 herself has supported the case of prosecution and in fact in her cross-examination in Para '5' she has denied that she was raped.
It is lastly submitted that the petitioner has clean antecedent and is languishing in custody since 17.10.2024.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and taking into account that the informant and her mother during the course of trial has not supported the prosecution case, let the petitioner above-named be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Sub-Divisional Dinesh Paswan @ Dinesh Kumar Paswan vs The State Of Bihar on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181841748/
